title: Publish › ZIP: a backup whose database copy did not finish (BACKUP_NOT_FULL) is said in two plain paragraphs, not the generic sentence with the code, and Try again makes a new backup
steps: S1: Open the ZIP step of the Publish tab and press Prepare ZIP on a site whose export ends failed with error BACKUP_NOT_FULL.
S2: Read the error notice of the step.
expect: S2: [data-export-failed] holds two paragraphs: 'Tracy could not finish a full backup of your site, so the ZIP was not made. …' and 'Press Try again to make a new backup. …'; the text '(BACKUP_NOT_FULL)' does not appear.
S3: a second fresh backup is requested.

selectors.tool: node --test DOM test of the ZIP step (jsdom)

evidence: Before the fix the notice read 'The ZIP could not be prepared or downloaded (BACKUP_NOT_FULL).' (the new test failed on exactly that sentence)
fence: The real ZIP step and its hook in jsdom with the export doors stubbed (export status answers failed BACKUP_NOT_FULL); English words of the plugin's own table

tests: ZIP: a backup whose database copy did not finish says so in words, and Try again makes a new backup
